sqlMap.select: SELECT SELECTR, INSERTR, UPDATER, DELETER FROM SY_USER, SY_USER_RELATION, SY_ROLE_GROUP_RELATION, SY_ROLE_RELATION WHERE SY_USER.USER_NO = SY_USER_RELATION.USER_NO(+) AND SY_USER_RELATION.ROLE_GROUP_NO = SY_ROLE_GROUP_RELATION.ROLE_GROUP_NO(+) AND SY_ROLE_GROUP_RELATION.ROLE_NO = SY_ROLE_RELATION.ROLE_NO AND SY_USER.USER_NO = #USER_NO:VARCHAR# AND SY_ROLE_RELATION.MENU_NO = #menuNo:VARCHAR#
